_comment: Human corrections applied after the merge, beating every source. Every entry needs a reason. Setting verified:true asserts a person compared this against a printed card.

overrides.reason: Card reads 7/8; Cerebro has injured 7. OCR read 8 off the card and this was confirmed against the printed card. Injured stamina above healthy is normal in MCP — six other characters show the same pattern and all agree with their sources.

overrides.reason: Read against the card. Shadow Bolt's bullets are in the reverse order and both lead with Failure; Dark Miasma's icons are Critical, Wild, Hit, Failure; Flames of the Faltine refers to itself by the Leadership star, fires in the Cleanup Phase, and triggers at 5 Power; Feel the Power of Darkness and Master of the Realm of Darkness were paraphrased; the three Immunities are separate keyword powers. Ability names were transcribed in the card's display capitals rather than in prose case as every other character has them.

FLAMES OF THE FALTINE (AFFILIATION: DARK.name: Flames of the Faltine (Affiliation: Dark Dimension)
FLAMES OF THE FALTINE (AFFILIATION: DARK.text: If Dormammu is included in a squad, that squad is affiliated with Dark Dimension and must use this {LEADERSHIP}. This character and each other character you control gains 1 additional {PWR} during the Power Phase. During the Cleanup Phase, if another allied character has 5 or more {PWR} it suffers 1 {DMG}.

FEEL THE POWER OF DARKNESS!.name: Feel the Power of Darkness!
FEEL THE POWER OF DARKNESS!.text: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. The attacking character gains the Hex special condition and is Pushed Away from this character {S}. If the attacking character already had the Hex special condition, it gains the Incinerate special condition.

MASTER OF THE REALM OF DARKNESS.name: Master of the Realm of Darkness
MASTER OF THE REALM OF DARKNESS.text:
When this character suffers {DMG} from an enemy effect it gains 1 {PWR} instead of {PWR} equal to the {DMG} suffered. When another allied character is damaged by an enemy effect or by Flames of the Faltine, this character gains 1 {PWR}.
Additionally, when attacking, at the end of the Modify Dice step, add 1 {FAIL} result to this character's roll for each {FAIL} in the defense roll. When attacking, this character adds {FAIL} results in its roll to its total successes.
